metadata.title: Adivasi movements to save Zameen, Jungle and Jal | ज़मीन की लड़ाई दिल्ली पहुंचेगी
metadata.description: There are at least 80 movements going on to save land in the country. Bhoomi Adhikar Andolan has claimed that Hasdeo Arand, Deucha Panchami and many other movements of Adivasis happening all of the country to save the resources and livelihood by the tribal communities. Now at least 70 organisations have decided to launch a big protest in Delhi on December 10 to support these movements of people.
